signInSubtitle: Sign in to Oboya CRM with your work account.
authFailed: The link is invalid or has expired. Please try again.
errorInactive: Your account is not active. Contact a CRM administrator.
unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
resetSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetLinkExpired: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
updatePasswordFailed: Could not update the password. Please try again.
changeSubtitle: For your security, set a new password before continuing.
mfaEnrollSubtitle: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to finish setup.
mfaChallengeSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfaUnavailable: Two-step verification is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
mfaQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfaRequired: Two-step verification is required. Complete it to continue.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
casdoorFailed: Casdoor sign-in failed. Please try again.
casdoorStateExpired: The Casdoor authorization expired. Please start again from the login page.
casdoorSessionLost: Your CRM session was lost. Sign in to the CRM first, then retry linking.
casdoorTokenFailed: Casdoor rejected the authorization code exchange. Check CASDOOR_CLIENT_SECRET in Vercel.
casdoorProfileFailed: Could not read your Casdoor profile. Ask an administrator to check the app's OIDC scopes.
casdoorLinkConflict: This Casdoor account is linked to another CRM user, or this CRM account is already linked to a different Casdoor account.
casdoorPendingApproval: Your Casdoor sign-in is waiting for CRM administrator approval. Ask an administrator in Setup → Users to review it.
casdoorAccessRejected: This Casdoor account was not approved for CRM access. Contact an administrator.
casdoorDomainNotAllowed: This Casdoor email domain is not allowed for CRM access. Use your work account.
casdoorAccountTypeNotAllowed: This Casdoor account type is not allowed for CRM access. Use a work account.
casdoorOrganizationNotAllowed: This Casdoor organization is not allowed for CRM access. Contact an administrator.
